## POST `/api/2.58/array-connections/connection-keys`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates new one-time connection key to allow establishing connection to this array. Key is valid until successful connection is established or its expiration time is reached. Note, this is the only time the connection key is displayed, it cannot be retrieved subsequently.

| `type` | string | The type of replication. Valid values are `async-replication` and `sync-replication`. |
